# detected by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:detectedBy`](gmeow-detectedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/detectedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/ai`](../../slices/ai.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The agent (a person, an NLI model, an evaluation run's judge) that surfaced this contradiction. Attributed because detection is contestable. Not [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md), which is domained on [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md) — a [`Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) is a relator between claims, not itself a claim.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) -> [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:detectedBy`](gmeow-detectedBy.md) from [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) to [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md), [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to attribute a [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) to the agent that surfaced it — a person, an NLI model, or an eval run's judge — because detection is itself contestable.

### Avoid when

- Avoid reaching for [`gmeow:vantage`](gmeow-vantage.md) (that is domained on [`Observation`](../classes/gmeow-Observation.md); a [`Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) is a relator between claims, not a claim) and avoid omitting the detector — an unattributed contradiction cannot be contested.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:detectedBy`](gmeow-detectedBy.md) at the detecting [`gmeow:Agent`](../classes/gmeow-Agent.md); rival detectors of the same conflict are separate [`gmeow:Contradiction`](../classes/gmeow-Contradiction.md) individuals rather than several detectors on one.
